trane.notes: XV/XR/XL names: Trane retired them with its R-454B lineup. Its 25C certificate lists the old R-410A names with 4-prefix models (XV20i = 4TWV0, XV18 = 4TWV8, XR17 = 4TWR7, XL17i = 4TWX7, XR15 = 4TWR5, XL15i = 4TWX5) next to the new names with matching 5-prefix models (e.g. 20 TruComfort = 5TWV0). The ductless page says Trane has 'partnered with Mitsubishi' and gives no warranty terms. Trane mentions labs at its Tyler, Texas plant but doesn't say where each line is built. innovair-group.notes: Innovair: The Q-Series warranty card PDF (innovair.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/2025_Innovair_Q_SERIES_Warranty_Card__0826B.pdf) couldn't be read (fetch proxy rate limit). Innovair markets the Q Series with 'extreme cold climate performance' but gives no temperature, so claim is null. Q Series uses R-32 on entry models and R-454B on others, so refrigerant is null. The Slim24 page doesn't name its refrigerant (Slim4 is R-454B). Innovair also lists T32 (R-32) and GT4 (R-454B) lines whose heat-pump status wasn't clear, so they're omitted. Factory location isn't disclosed. | Stelpro: The brief says Stelpro's heat pumps are 'certified via Innovair'. Stelpro's pages list AHRI reference numbers but don't name the certifying manufacturer, and I couldn't query the AHRI directory, so this is unverified. Stelpro doesn't say where its heat pumps are made. coldClimate is true only where Stelpro shows an ENERGY STAR Cold Climate mark (Elite B). Pro B, Multi B and Slim B list heating operation to -30°C, but that's an operating limit, not a capacity rating. The US registration rules aren't published separately; the limited-warranty PDF on file is Canadian (Quebec law). | Dettson: The brief cites Chinook as a heat pump, but Dettson lists Chinook and Chinook Compact as modulating gas furnaces. Dettson's 2026 heat pump page lists Innovair M4+, M4+ Multizone, Q4 and Slim4+, and Gree R32 Airy, Charmo, Clivia, Flexx (central), Freematch (multizone) and Versati IV (air-to-water). Only the two Innovair lines with published cold-weather claims are listed in 'lines'; the Gree pages weren't read. dettson.com's root page blocks automated fetching, but its /en-ca/ and /fr-ca/ pages loaded normally. Older Dettson-branded heat pumps (e.g., Alizé) don't appear in the 2026 catalogue. | Ouellet: coldClimate is false for every Ouellet line because no low-temperature claim was found. Only the Harmony page and the R32 series listing were read; Olympia, Pacific, Myriad Plus and Flexx weren't opened individually, so check them before publishing a cold-climate verdict. Ouellet's 'Flexx' central and 'Myriad Plus' names match Gree products Dettson resells ('Gree R32 Flexx'), which suggests Gree builds them, but Ouellet doesn't say so (manufacturing null). Capella is a separate heat pump site linked from Ouellet's residential menu; its owner isn't named there. The Oct 5, 2026 Quebec legal warranty comes from Quebec's planned-obsolescence consumer law as cited in Ouellet's documents; it likely applies to all brands sold in Quebec, but that was only verified in Ouellet's text.
